payload.title: Quitar llamadas manuales de sync en project-resolvers.ts (contract, lote 3/3)
payload.description:
## Parent
Despacho único de sync (candidato B del architecture review), continúa AT-191.

## What to build
Las 7 mutations de project-resolvers.ts (projectCreate, projectUpdate, projectArchive, projectUnarchive, milestoneCreate, milestoneUpdate, milestoneDelete) dejan de llamar a repo?.sync a mano.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cero `repo?.sync` manual en project-resolvers.ts
- [ ] bun test en verde

## Blocked by
AT-191 — corre en paralelo con los otros dos lotes.
